cases.prompt: I want to release my cozy farming game on Steam next month. I haven't made a store page yet.
expect: Explains the 2-week Coming Soon minimum and review lead time
Recommends pushing the date out so wishlists can build; warns against shadow dropping
Does not promise a wishlist number

cases.prompt: Review my Steam page: capsule is AI art with the text 'Best cozy game 2026!', tags are Indie, Casual, Simulation.
expect: Flags slogan text on capsule as against capsule rules
Flags AI capsule art as highest backlash risk and points to ai-disclosure
Scores items with ✅/⚠️/❌ and one fix each

cases.prompt: Should I join Steam Next Fest now? I have 300 wishlists and a buggy demo.
expect: Explains one Next Fest per game
Cites that pre-fest wishlists predict results (median ~322-462 for <1,000)
Recommends releasing and polishing the demo first
Presents numbers as ranges with sources

cases.prompt: 帮我检查 steam_assets 文件夹里的图片尺寸。
expect: Reports missing required sizes and reminds to verify on Steamworks
